title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: In 4-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$4$$ parts. Each part is used as a validation set once, while the other $$3$$ parts are used for training.

title: Number of Observations and Features
text: The model has $$30$$ observations and $$29$$ features plus an intercept. This means each fold will have $$7$$ or $$8$$ observations in the validation set.

title: Properties of Cross-Validation
text: In cross-validation, each data point is used for validation exactly once. This ensures that the model is tested on all data points.
